verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents the bring-your-own-backend half of the story: any OpenAI-compatible provider can be added with a custom Base URL, and existing coding-agent subscriptions (Codex, Claude Code, etc.) can serve as chat backends. Nothing in the pack shows token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation, which is the visibility half of the story. Missing for 10: token usage display, cost tracking per model, cost/usage per conversation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: anything that speaks the OpenAI API (Ollama, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio, Groq, ...) is added as provider OpenAI with a custom Base URL.
Use that subscription as a native chat backend; no API key is needed.
With support for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, it gives you a powerful, provider-agnostic interface for both local and cloud-based models.
